args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

handleClick's promise chain only calls setBusy(false) in the success (.then) branch, so a rejected exportReport() call (thrown when res.ok is false) leaves busy stuck true and the select/button permanently disabled. Add a .catch (or wrap in try/finally) so setBusy(false) runs on failure too, and show an error toast in that path.

handleClick only calls setBusy(false) in the success branch of the exportReport() promise chain; since exportReport() throws when res.ok is false, a failed export leaves busy stuck true and the button/select permanently disabled.
